connector.name: Acmi MCP
connector.registryDescription: Persistent agent memory via ACMI - Profile/Signals/Timeline. 16 tools on Upstash Redis.
connector.summary: Hosted at server.smithery.ai over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package acmi-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the madezmedia account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
